whoItsFor: Developers who want an AI coding agent that runs multi-model, parallel agent workflows from a single command. The README is mostly marketing copy and does not state concrete setup requirements.
useCases: Automating multi-step coding tasks in a codebase with an agent that plans, implements, and verifies changes
Running large parallel research or pipeline jobs split across several models
Migrating existing OpenCode or LazyCodex setups to OmO while keeping provider keys and MCP servers
